div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 900px; text-align: center;

span.p:
1. The planner records a rule
Scenarios page, CLI or POST /scenarios/{id}/edits: an area,
a feature type, an attribute and a value, stored as a row of
curated_geo.scenario_edit under an app_core.scenario

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 900px; text-align: center;

span.p:
2. Recompute materialises the rules
POST /scenarios/{id}/recompute or the CLI scenario recompute:
materialize_scenario resolves each rule into per-feature rows of
curated_geo.scenario_override, refusing values above a ceiling

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 900px; text-align: center;

span.p:
3. A scenario asset version is published
so that freshness resolution sees the edit

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 900px; text-align: center;

span.p:
4. The impact engine resolves the dirty set
Only the indicators that read an edited attribute,
plus every indicator that depends on them

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 900px; text-align: center;

span.p:
5. A run is submitted and executed
Deduplicated by a content fingerprint, enqueued on the DBOS
runs queue; the worker takes units from the units queue
in dependency waves, checkpointing each

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 900px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 900px; text-align: center;

span.p:
7. The client compares by scenario
GET /scenarios/{id}/comparison; an indicator the scenario
did not recompute falls back to its baseline value

svg.text: Figure 7 — Dynamic: authoring a scenario edit and recomputing its indicators
